GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (9 Jan 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1451)
APO 500
9 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Provisions for Escort Vessel 118.
1. Escort Vessel 118 now at Sasebo Naval Base will be supplied with necessary provisions for the movement of 145 Japanese Nationals from Sasebo to Tokyo Bay.
2. Movement is expected to take place on or about 14 January 1947.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
